_comment: Fixed BEFORE the first measurement run. 8 commits mined from gitpixel history. No cherry-picking: these are all non-merge, non-docs-only, non-initial commits in the repo. The repo has only 10 non-merge commits total (1 docs-only skipped, 1 initial-commit skipped), leaving exactly 8. Gold file set = ALL files the commit actually modified (per spec). File-count range is 2-31, deviating from the design's 2-8 target — only 2 of 8 commits fall in that range. This is a hard constraint of the repo's young history and is documented in the writeup. Note: gold sets include non-code files (Cargo.lock, README.md, .gitignore, etc.) which agents are unlikely to name, creating a systematic recall ceiling — this is reported honestly, not adjusted away.

tasks.task: Make short query tokens searchable and rank results by rarity instead of recency in the transcript retrieval system

tasks.subject: feat(sniper): run wrapper with tsc parsing and structured failure records

tasks.task: Add a fast static embedding tier as the default for semantic search, fix a backfill deduplication bug where the same batch was re-chunked many times, and tune the lexical search channel to skip orchestrator turns and drop overly common query words

tasks.subject: feat: add gitpixel-sniper crate — error sink store, query, CLI, MCP server

tasks.subject: feat(cli,graph): add sniper targets + rescue — closed task scoping & surgical revert
tasks.task: Add a command that takes a task description and returns a closed, prioritized file list, and a command that plans a safe revert for scenarios where something was working before

tasks.task: Add a JavaScript companion package with a Vite dev plugin for error capture, a zero-dependency browser client, and a vitest reporter that emits structured records to the error sink
